stem: What was one of President Nixon’s goals for the meeting shown in this photograph?
instruction: Study the photograph and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: To negotiate the withdrawal of U.S. and Chinese soldiers from Korea

options.label: B
options.text: To create a military alliance with China against the Soviet Union

options.label: C
options.text: To create an agreement limiting Chinese and Soviet development of nuclear weapons

options.label: D
options.text: To normalize relations between the United States and China

visual_elements: Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party Mao Zedong Shakes Hands with U.S. President Richard Nixon, February 29, 1971
Black and white photograph of Mao Zedong and Richard Nixon shaking hands
